593:t_056:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Good...! Keep intercepting the enemy just like that!」

593:t_056:1.en:
$$ミネバ$$
($c... I believe you can overcome any hardship.)

593:t_100:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! Are you really determined to fight!?」

593:t_100:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「You've finally decided to fight, too, $$バナージ$$!」

593:t_100:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「No...! $$バナージ$$ isn't fighting to defeat you! He's fighting to talk to you!」

593:t_100:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「You're still spouting that nonsense at a time like this!?」

593:t_100:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Whatever anyone says, I'll act the way I believe I should!」

593:t_100:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So, Ensign $$リディ$$! I'll fight to stop you!」

593:t_101:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「With this power, even if I'm facing Captain $$アムロ$$...!」

593:t_101:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Clear your mind, Ensign $$リディ$$! You're drowning in your emotions and losing sight of what matters!」

593:t_101:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The talent I had such hopes for in you shouldn't have awakened for you to do this!」

593:t_101:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「I... have no choice but to do this!」

593:t_101:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't justify letting circumstances sweep you along, $$リディ$$! Remember what really matters!」

593:t_102:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! This isn't how the fight between you and me was supposed to be settled!」

593:t_102:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's in the past, $$カミーユ$$! If you get in my way, I'll shoot you down as an enemy, too!」

593:t_102:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I won't lose to you while you're drowning in your emotions!」

593:t_102:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Snap out of it, Ensign! This is the wrong way to express that purity of yours!」

593:t_103:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! If you've joined $$クロノ$$, I won't hesitate to fight you!」

593:t_103:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's right, $$シン$$! I'll break through you and crush $$バナージ$$... the $$ユニコーン$$!」

593:t_103:2.en:
$$シン$$
「Damn it! Do you think I actually want to fight you, Ensign!?」

593:t_103:3.en:
$$シン$$
「Brace yourself, Ensign! I'm going to get rough to bring you to your senses!」

593:t_104:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! I believe you're still the same person who fought alongside us in $$オーブ$$!」

593:t_104:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Don't think those words will make me flinch, $$キラ$$! I turned against you to protect the world!」

593:t_104:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「I still believe it! Your feelings are just as pure now as they were then!」

593:t_104:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's why I'll stop you, so you can turn those feelings in the right direction!」

593:t_105:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you come at me, I'll just take you down.」

593:t_105:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's fine! I swore to put my life on the line to protect the world!」

593:t_105:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You say you intend to die for your mission, but all I hear is empty bravado.」

593:t_105:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I can't let a man like that keep fighting...!」

593:t_106:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Keep your heart strong! That $$ガンダム$$ is consuming you!」

593:t_106:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「This $$バンシィ$$ has become my arms and legs, my power to protect the world! You have no right to criticize me!」

593:t_106:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「If all you do is reject others with force, the fighting will never end!」

593:t_106:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you open your heart, that $$ガンダム$$ should show even greater power!」

593:t_106:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「What I need now is the power to destroy you! The $$バンシィ$$ gives me that!」

593:t_107:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The guy standing in front of me is nothing like the guy I've heard about!」

593:t_107:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Say what you like! I chose this path of my own free will!」

593:t_107:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If that just means chasing $$バナージ$$, your resolve doesn't sound like much!」

593:t_107:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I don't know what happened to you, but if you're targeting my friends, you're my enemy!」

593:t_107:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Here I come! I've got no ties to hold me back, so I'll stop you!」

593:t_108:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Please stop fighting! Nobody wants to fight you!」

593:t_108:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then get out of my way! Don't interfere with my fight with $$バナージ$$!」

593:t_108:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We're trying to stop you because we don't want to see you and $$バナージ$$ fight!」

593:t_108:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If you won't understand that, I have a plan of my own!」

593:t_109:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
($$リディ$$... Go beyond your limits.)

593:t_109:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
(Go beyond your emotions, your thoughts, your ties, and your past! Then you should be able to face who you are more honestly!)

593:t_109:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
(You're not a man whose life should end in a place like this!)

593:t_110:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$...! I'll stop you and beat some sense into you!」

593:t_110:1.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
(Please understand, Ensign $$リディ$$... We have reasons why we can't back down, too.)

593:t_111:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「You're in my way, $n! Don't think you can stop me!」

593:t_111:1.en:
$n
「That's my line! Don't think you can get past me!」

593:t_111:3.en:
$n
「I'll repay you for training me by stopping this fight between you and $$バナージ$$!」

593:t_112:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I've been looking forward to seeing you, $n! Now let's fight with the $$スフィア$$ at stake!」

593:t_112:1.en:
$n
「$$アムブリエル$$! If I win, you're giving Miss $$スズネ$$ back!」

593:t_112:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Oh...? You make it sound as if $$スズネ$$ belonged to you.」

593:t_112:3.en:
$n
「Your wisecracks don't make my heart skip a beat, $$アムブリエル$$!」

593:t_112:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You've learned to talk back! Even a lousy student can grow a little!」

593:t_112:5.en:
$n
「Don't act like you're my teacher! Only Miss $$スズネ$$ has the right to say that!」

593:t_112:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Then come on! Let's play with your $$スフィア$$ and my $$スズネ$$ as our chips!」

593:t_113:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Please stop! We don't want to fight you, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

593:t_113:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Stop dreaming. The person standing here is someone other than your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$.」

593:t_113:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then I'll drive you out of Miss $$スズネ$$'s body!」

593:t_113:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's why we'll stop you ourselves!」

593:t_113:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! Please hold on just a little longer!」

593:t_113:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What a bunch of pests. Do you miss $$スズネ$$ that much?」

593:t_113:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yes! We're definitely getting Miss $$スズネ$$ back!」

593:t_113:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「I won't let you get near $n!」

593:t_113:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's right, you slut! I won't let you keep speaking through Miss $$スズネ$$'s body!」

593:t_113:10.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If you're going to talk like that, I'll finish you off before I deal with $n!」

593:t_114:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Stay out of my way, $$リアクター$$s! I'll deal with you once I get the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$!」

593:t_114:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Like hell you will! I'll stop you before that happens!」

593:t_114:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We'll take you on for $n's sake, too!」

593:t_114:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Dealing with hysterical women isn't my idea of fun, but this isn't the time to be picky!」

593:t_114:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Every last one of you gets in my way...!」
